tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background behind every card, the sidebar and the topbar.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, sidebar, topbar. The default ground for text.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Popovers, tooltips, dialogs, the command palette. Always paired with shadow-pop and border.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells inside a card: code and log blocks, expanded detail panels, table header rows, the segmented-control track.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fill for rows, nav items and ghost buttons on surface. Also meter tracks and skeleton blocks.

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Scrim behind dialogs, the mobile drawer and the command palette.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairline: card outlines, dividers, table rules. Decorative, never the only signal.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Emphasised hairline: hovered cards, selected rows, separators that must read at a glance. Still decorative.

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: Outline of inputs, selects, checkboxes and outline buttons. Holds 3:1 on bg, surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: ring
tokens.usage: Focus ring, 2px solid with a 2px offset. Holds 3:1 on every surface.

tokens.name: fg
tokens.usage: Primary text and numerals on bg, surface, surface-raised, surface-sunken and surface-hover.

tokens.name: fg-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: labels, descriptions, table cells of lower rank. Reads on bg, surface, surface-raised, surface-sunken and surface-hover.

tokens.name: fg-subtle
tokens.usage: Tertiary text: captions, axis ticks, timestamps, placeholders. Reads on bg, surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: fg-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled controls only. Not held to a contrast floor; never use for content.

tokens.name: fg-on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill (primary button, active badge).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Clay, the one brand colour. Primary button fill, active tab underline, limit meters below 70%, the Claude series. Never a second accent beside it.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover state of an accent fill.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground for the selected nav item, selected chips and accent callouts.

tokens.name: accent-fg
tokens.usage: Clay-coloured text and icons: links, the active nav label, text on accent-soft. Reads on bg, surface, surface-raised and accent-soft.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Healthy state marks: under-limit meters, completed dots, running pulse. Always with a word or icon.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Ground for a success badge or callout.

tokens.name: success-fg
tokens.usage: Success text on surface and on success-soft.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Limit usage at 70% and above, stalled agents, caps close to breach. Always with a word or icon.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Ground for a warning badge or callout.

tokens.name: warning-fg
tokens.usage: Warning text on surface and on warning-soft.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Limit usage at 90% and above, reached limits, failed runs, agents waiting on the user. Always with a word or icon.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Ground for a danger badge or callout.

tokens.name: danger-fg
tokens.usage: Danger text on surface and on danger-soft.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Neutral notices: update available, passive data in use, tips.

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Ground for an info badge or callout.

tokens.name: info-fg
tokens.usage: Info text on surface and on info-soft.

tokens.name: chart-grid
tokens.usage: Chart gridlines. Horizontal only; no vertical grid.

tokens.name: chart-axis
tokens.usage: Axis ticks and labels (the fg-subtle value, kept separate so charts can be tuned alone).

tokens.name: chart-cursor
tokens.usage: Hover band behind the bar or point under the pointer.

tokens.name: platform-claude
tokens.usage: The Claude series wherever Claude and Codex are compared (Both view).

tokens.name: platform-codex
tokens.usage: The Codex series wherever Claude and Codex are compared. Same value in both themes; 3:1 or better on surface in each.

tokens.name: heat-0
tokens.usage: Heatmap cell with no activity.

tokens.name: heat-1
tokens.usage: Heatmap, lowest activity quartile.

tokens.name: heat-2
tokens.usage: Heatmap, second quartile.

tokens.name: heat-3
tokens.usage: Heatmap, third quartile. Dark enough in the dark theme for fg text at 4.5:1.

tokens.name: heat-4
tokens.usage: Heatmap, top quartile. The ramp runs by lightness, so it survives greyscale.

tokens.name: model-fable-1
tokens.usage: Fable 5.1. Red family: the most expensive tier. Model colours are fixed per model, never assigned by order.

tokens.name: model-fable-2
tokens.usage: Fable 5. The lighter red step. On white it turns toward rose: that is what clears 3:1 while staying apart from Fable 5.1.

tokens.name: model-mythos-1
tokens.usage: Mythos 5.1.

tokens.name: model-mythos-2
tokens.usage: Mythos 5 and Mythos Preview. Low contrast on dark by design; rarely rendered.

tokens.name: model-opus-1
tokens.usage: Opus 5.5. Amber family.

tokens.name: model-opus-2
tokens.usage: Opus 5 and 4.5 to 4.8. The brighter amber step on dark. On white no amber lighter than Opus 5.5 clears 3:1 and still reads as a different colour, so the light value takes the deep end of the family, below legacy Opus.

tokens.name: model-opus-3
tokens.usage: Legacy Opus (3.0, 4.0, 4.1).

tokens.name: model-sonnet-1
tokens.usage: Sonnet 5.5. Green family.

tokens.name: model-sonnet-2
tokens.usage: Sonnet 5 and older Sonnets.

tokens.name: model-haiku-1
tokens.usage: Haiku 4. Blue family: the cheapest Claude tier.

tokens.name: model-haiku-2
tokens.usage: Haiku 3.

tokens.name: model-haiku-3
tokens.usage: Legacy Haiku.

tokens.name: model-gpt-1
tokens.usage: GPT-6 Sol, GPT-5.6 Terra, GPT-5.3 Codex. Violet family: every OpenAI model.

tokens.name: model-gpt-2
tokens.usage: GPT-5.6 Sol and GPT-5.5.

tokens.name: model-gpt-3
tokens.usage: GPT-6 Astra and unlisted GPT-6 models. Low contrast on dark by design.

tokens.name: model-gpt-4
tokens.usage: GPT-6 Luna, GPT-5.6 Luna, GPT-5.4 Mini. The light violet step. On white it is darker and greyer, which leaves room for model-gpt-5 above it.

tokens.name: model-gpt-5
tokens.usage: Codex guardian auto-review and unlisted GPT models. The lightest violet step, darkened on white to clear 3:1.

tokens.name: model-unknown-1
tokens.usage: Off-ramp hue for a model the table does not know, picked by a stable hash of its name.

tokens.name: model-unknown-2
tokens.usage: Off-ramp hue for an unknown model.

tokens.name: model-unknown-3
tokens.usage: Off-ramp hue for an unknown model.

tokens.name: model-unknown-4
tokens.usage: Off-ramp hue for an unknown model.

tokens.name: tag-1
tokens.usage: First project tag a user creates. Tags take colours in creation order.

tokens.name: tag-2
tokens.usage: Second project tag.

tokens.name: tag-3
tokens.usage: Third project tag.

tokens.name: tag-4
tokens.usage: Fourth project tag.

tokens.name: tag-5
tokens.usage: Fifth project tag.

tokens.name: tag-6
tokens.usage: Sixth project tag.

tokens.name: tag-7
tokens.usage: Seventh project tag; the cycle restarts after it.

tokens.name: tag-untagged
tokens.usage: The catch-all Untagged bucket. Never drawn from the tag cycle.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Page title in the topbar. One per page.

styles.name: heading
styles.sample: What is contributing to your limits
styles.usage: Card and section titles. Sentence case, never uppercase.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Sidebar group names, stat-tile labels, table column heads. The only uppercase style.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default running text, table cells, form values.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Row titles, nav items, button labels.

styles.name: small
styles.sample: Estimated equivalent API cost, not a bill.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Timestamps, axis ticks, footnotes. 12px is the floor: nothing is set smaller.

styles.name: metric-lg
styles.usage: The one hero number of a card: a limit gauge, today's spend. Tabular figures.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: Durations, token counts in dense rows, paths, model ids, keyboard hints.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Code and log blocks, transcript tool calls.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label gap inside a chip; gap between a dot and its text.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between inline controls; vertical padding of a dense row.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Horizontal padding of buttons, inputs and rows; gap between a card title and its content.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between stat tiles; padding of compact cards and of the sidebar.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding. The default inset of every Section.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between cards and between page sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page gutter left and right of the content column at 1280px.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Top and bottom padding of an empty state.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Keyboard hints, heatmap cells, bar tops in charts.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, selects, chips, nav items, segmented controls.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and sections.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Dialogs and the command palette.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Status dots, progress tracks, count badges.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: The only shadow. Popovers, tooltips, dialogs and the command palette. Cards carry none: they are set apart by border.

tokens.name: sidebar-width
tokens.usage: Expanded sidebar.

tokens.name: sidebar-rail
tokens.usage: Collapsed sidebar: icons only.

tokens.name: topbar-height
tokens.usage: Sticky topbar.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Maximum width of the content column.

tokens.name: control-height
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, selects and segmented controls.

tokens.name: control-height-sm
tokens.usage: Controls inside a card header or a dense toolbar.
